summary: No performance findings. example_ranges is a single linear pass over a document's lines with constant state, replacing an earlier two-pass version that also built a masked copy of the whole text. The gates call it at most twice per document (once via parse_sections, once for the H1 scan) and only at sign-off, spec confirmation and doctor - none of which sit on a hot path. Documents are briefs and specs, measured in kilobytes.
residual_risks: doctor's legacy_capture_gaps scans every confirmed spec on each run. Linear in spec count on a human-triggered command; no action taken.
